system.description:
Your amazing throws bounce Grenades off walls into open hatches or through congested battle zones.

Prerequisite: Dexterity 13

Effect: When throwing a Grenade or grenadelike weapon, you can attempt to bounce it off a wall or other surface close to your target. If you attack roll exceeds a Reflex Defense of 15, you ignore Cover and Improved Cover (but not Total Cover) with your attack.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
